originalTitle: Intel upsizes stock offering to $20 billion at $95 per share as AI demand accelerates
summary: Technology giants have shelled out trillions to support insatiable AI demand and the infrastructure buildout.
content:
Intel announced on Tuesday it had upsized its previously announced common stock offering to $20 billion, with an offer price of $95 per share.

The chipmaker announced a $15 billion common stock offering on Monday to support skyrocketing customer demand for artificial intelligence computing power. Shares of Intel fell 4% in response.

Intel said the offering, set to close on August 12, is expected to raise net proceeds of $19.7 billion, after deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses.

Intel intends to use the proceeds "for general corporate purposes," it said, including, but not limited to, capital expenditures and working capital.

The chipmaker on Monday highlighted physical AI, purpose-built silicon and advance packaging among the major growth opportunities and said it will use the funding to support corporate needs, including capital expenditures and working capital,

Technology giants have shelled out trillions in recent years to meet insatiable AI demand and the unrelenting infrastructure build-out to support new compute capacity.

Several mega-cap tech companies boosted their capital expenditures on AI demand this earnings season, with spending on track to hit $765 billion this year and $1.2 trillion in 2027, according to estimates from Goldman Sachs . Amazon gave the highest guidance among the group this reporting period, citing the memory crunch.

Last month, Intel posted its fastest revenue growth in nearly 15 years and hiked capital expenditures guidance to $20 billion, citing strong customer demand.

At the time, finance chief David Zinsner said most of the spending would support factory tooling. He told CNBC that the company is bracing for a "meaningful increase" in 2027.

Intel shares have benefited over the last year from the AI infrastructure build-out and the U.S. government's 10% equity stake aimed at bolstering domestic chip manufacturing. The stock has surged 175% in 2026 and quintupled in value over the last year.

The Intel announcement includes a 30-day option that would allow underwriters to buy an additional $2.25 billion in common stock.
chineseTitle: 随着 AI 需求的加速，英特尔将股票发行规模扩大至 200 亿美元，每股 95 美元
chineseSummary: 科技巨头已斥资数万亿美元来支持永不满足的人工智能需求和基础设施建设。
chineseContent:
英特尔周二宣布，已将此前宣布的普通股发行规模扩大至 200 亿美元，发行价为每股 95 美元。

这家芯片制造商周一宣布发行 150 亿美元的普通股，以支持客户对人工智能计算能力飙升的需求。英特尔股价应声下跌 4%。

英特尔表示，此次发行定于 8 月 12 日结束，扣除承销折扣和佣金以及预计发行费用后，预计将筹集 197 亿美元的净收益。

英特尔表示，打算将所得收益“用于一般企业用途”，包括但不限于资本支出和营运资金。

这家芯片制造商周一强调了物理人工智能、专用芯片和先进封装等主要增长机会，并表示将利用这笔资金来支持企业需求，包括资本支出和营运资本。

近年来，科技巨头已斥资数万亿美元来满足永不满足的人工智能需求和不断扩建的基础设施以支持新的计算能力。

据高盛估计，几家大型科技公司在本财报季增加了针对人工智能需求的资本支出，今年的支出有望达到 7650 亿美元，到 2027 年将达到 1.2 万亿美元。亚马逊以内存短缺为由，在本报告期内给出了该集团中最高的指引。

上个月，英特尔公布了近 15 年来最快的收入增长，并将资本支出指导上调至 200 亿美元，理由是客户需求强劲。

当时，财务主管戴维·津斯纳 (David Zinsner) 表示，大部分支出将用于支持工厂模具。他告诉 CNBC，该公司正准备在 2027 年实现“有意义的增长”。

去年，英特尔股价受益于人工智能基础设施建设以及美国政府旨在支持国内芯片制造的 10% 股权。该股在 2026 年飙升了 175%，价值比去年翻了五倍。

英特尔的公告包括一项为期 30 天的选择权，允许承销商额外购买 22.5 亿美元的普通股。
